visual.name: brightness
visual.description: Intensity of light emitted or reflected.

visual.name: opacity
visual.description: Degree to which light is blocked.

visual.name: transparency
visual.description: Degree to which light passes through.

visual.name: glossiness
visual.description: Shiny appearance due to light reflection.

visual.name: shape
visual.description: Form or outline of an object.

visual.name: size
visual.description: Dimensions or extent of an object.

visual.name: length
visual.description: Measurement of an object from end to end.

visual.name: visibility
visual.description: Degree to which something is perceptible visually.

visual.name: resolution
visual.description: Clarity or detail of visual representation.

tactile_haptic.name: elasticity
tactile_haptic.description: Ability to return to original shape after deformation.

tactile_haptic.name: plasticity
tactile_haptic.description: Ability to be molded or shaped.

tactile_haptic.name: brittleness
tactile_haptic.description: Tendency to break or crack easily.

tactile_haptic.name: compressibility
tactile_haptic.description: Ability to decrease in volume under pressure.

tactile_haptic.name: stretchability
tactile_haptic.description: Extent to which material can stretch.

tactile_haptic.name: malleability
tactile_haptic.description: Ability to be reshaped without cracking.

tactile_haptic.name: abrasiveness
tactile_haptic.description: Ability to wear away other surfaces.

functional.name: mobility
functional.description: Ease of moving or being moved.

functional.name: maintainability
functional.description: Ease of keeping functional or repairing.

functional.name: compatibility
functional.description: Ability to work well with others.

economic.name: cost
economic.description: Monetary value required for purchase or use.

economic.name: market_value
economic.description: Economic worth or price in the marketplace.

economic.name: durability
economic.description: Length of usable life or reliability.

auditory.name: loudness
auditory.description: Perceived volume or amplitude of sound.

auditory.name: pitch
auditory.description: Perceived frequency of sound, how high or low it sounds.

auditory.name: timbre
auditory.description: Quality or color of a sound that distinguishes it from others.

auditory.name: resonance
auditory.description: Richness and reverberation quality of sound.

auditory.name: clarity
auditory.description: Clearness or precision of a sound signal.

auditory.name: sharpness
auditory.description: Degree of high-frequency content in sound.

auditory.name: harmony
auditory.description: Pleasing combination of simultaneous musical tones.

auditory.name: rhythm
auditory.description: Pattern and timing of sound beats or pulses.

auditory.name: duration
auditory.description: Length of time a sound persists.

auditory.name: reverberation
auditory.description: Persistence of sound after it is produced.

auditory.name: noise_level
auditory.description: Intensity of unwanted or background sound.

auditory.name: frequency
auditory.description: Objective measure of cycles per second (Hz) of a sound wave.

auditory.name: intensity
auditory.description: Physical energy of the sound wave.

chemical.name: taste
chemical.description: Overall gustatory sensation from food or drink.

chemical.name: bitterness
chemical.description: Sharp and often unpleasant taste perception.

chemical.name: spiciness
chemical.description: Perception of heat or pungency in food.

chemical.name: smell
chemical.description: Olfactory sensation detected through the nose.

chemical.name: pleasantness
chemical.description: Degree to which a smell or taste is enjoyable.

chemical.name: pungency
chemical.description: Sharp or stinging quality in odor or taste.

chemical.name: acidity
chemical.description: Chemical sharpness often tasted or smelled.

chemical.name: freshness
chemical.description: Perception of newness or cleanliness in smell or taste.

chemical.name: toxicity
chemical.description: Harmful or poisonous property often linked to taste/smell.

physical_structural.name: mass
physical_structural.description: Amount of matter contained in an object.

physical_structural.name: weight
physical_structural.description: Gravitational force acting on an object.

physical_structural.name: density
physical_structural.description: Mass per unit volume of a substance.

physical_structural.name: volume
physical_structural.description: Space occupied by an object.

physical_structural.name: thickness
physical_structural.description: Distance between two opposite surfaces of an object.

physical_structural.name: strength
physical_structural.description: Ability to withstand force without breaking.

physical_structural.name: speed
physical_structural.description: Rate of movement or action.

physical_structural.name: conductivity
physical_structural.description: Ability to conduct electricity or heat.

physical_structural.name: thermal_conductivity
physical_structural.description: Ability to transfer heat.

physical_structural.name: electrical_conductivity
physical_structural.description: Ability to conduct electrical current.

physical_structural.name: solubility
physical_structural.description: Ability to dissolve in another substance.

physical_structural.name: porosity
physical_structural.description: Measure of empty spaces in a material.

physical_structural.name: permeability
physical_structural.description: Ability of material to allow fluids to pass through.

physical_structural.name: flammability
physical_structural.description: Ease with which a substance can ignite and burn.

physical_structural.name: magnetism
physical_structural.description: Ability to attract or repel other materials through magnetic force.

physical_structural.name: radioactivity
physical_structural.description: Emission of radiation from a substance.

physical_structural.name: durability
physical_structural.description: Ability to withstand wear, pressure, or damage.

physical_structural.name: stability
physical_structural.description: Resistance to change or degradation over time.

physical_structural.name: buoyancy
physical_structural.description: Ability to float in a fluid.

physical_structural.name: friction
physical_structural.description: Resistance that one surface or object encounters when moving over another.

physical_structural.name: adhesion
physical_structural.description: Ability of dissimilar particles or surfaces to cling to one another.

physical_structural.name: cohesion
physical_structural.description: Attraction between molecules of the same substance.

physical_structural.name: compressive_strength
physical_structural.description: Capacity to withstand loads tending to reduce size.

physical_structural.name: tensile_strength
physical_structural.description: Maximum stress a material can withstand while being stretched.

physical_structural.name: flexural_strength
physical_structural.description: Ability to resist deformation under load.

physical_structural.name: expansion
physical_structural.description: Increase in size or volume.

physical_structural.name: corrosion_resistance
physical_structural.description: Ability to withstand damage caused by oxidization or chemical reactions.

physical_structural.name: ductility
physical_structural.description: Ability to be stretched into a wire without breaking.

physical_structural.name: thermal_expansion
physical_structural.description: Tendency of matter to change in volume in response to temperature change.

physical_structural.name: shear_strength
physical_structural.description: Ability to resist forces that cause parts of a material to slide past one another.

physical_structural.name: impact_resistance
physical_structural.description: Ability to absorb shock or sudden force without breaking.
